description: The SAP S/4HANA Sales connector provides APIs that enable seamless integration with the [Billing Document - Read, Cancel, GetPDF API v1.1.0](https://api.sap.com/api/API_BILLING_DOCUMENT_SRV/overview). The service allows to read and cancel billing documents and retrieve their PDF versions.
key-features: Read billing documents, items, partners, pricing elements, and texts from SAP S/4HANA
Cancel billing documents and retrieve billing documents as PDF
Seamless integration with the Billing Document - Read, Cancel, GetPDF API v1.1.0
Support for basic and OAuth 2.0 authentication
